mentions.name: Odin Cross-Platform Game Framework
mentions.description: This is a cross-platform game framework written for/in the Odin programming language. Its scope is intentionally smaller than Unity, Godot or Unreal: it makes the decisions beginners get stuck on so they can focus on making a game. It also serves as the foundation for the builder's first Steam release, with plans to ship on Steam first, work through bugs, and then open the framework up for general use.
mentions.problem: Beginners get stuck on engine/framework decisions when starting game development.
mentions.audience: Beginners in game development who get stuck on framework/engine decisions and want to be freed up to make a game.
mentions.source_excerpt: Cross-platform game framework for/in the Odin programming language. It's also the foundation for my first Steam release. The plan is to get something out on Steam, roll with the punches (bugs,) then open it up for general-use. I say "framework" instead of "engine" because the scope of the project is to make the decisions the beginners get stuck on and free them to make a game.
